evidence_class: Original-byte asserted Xtensa translation; literal source-derived timer/IFTTT formats, not a firmware boot
evidence: CatalogQuirks/AV/probe_schedule.py, probe_metadata.py, probe_dispatch.py and their *-probe-results.json artifacts in private gree-research
policy: Timers use a synthetic mainboard cache; modeled writes stage that cache without physical UART or flash. IFTTT safely owns copied records instead of reproducing observed source repeated cJSON_Delete calls; this is not original-allocator success. Atomic validation bounds timer names to the 19-byte terminated board-report field and condition/selector counts to their fixed storage. Clock metadata requires a complete calendar timestamp rather than the source sscanf partial-input/uninitialized-stack behavior. No autonomous timer/condition execution or firmware upgrade completion is claimed.
metadata_ack_policy: Metadata p uses the current network getter, not a request echo. Old name val is the last staged child-name string; modern name val is the synthetic empty staging string. host/apssid/appsw/time report effective cache values in both arrays. AV20/AV30/BV30 clock setters use a different buffer from the time getter, so time readback and acknowledgement remain unchanged. Lock/name duplicates report final shared metadata state.
nested_rule_command: Base64 of a strict JSON object with integer i and encrypted string pack; unlike a network envelope it does not require t. Nested duplicate keys, nonfinite values, invalid Unicode and non-string pack are rejected atomically. The LAN envelope validator remains unchanged.
control_only_descriptor_policy: All ten original AV/BV builds transmit ExWdSpd as UART offset91/length1 and their internal numeric getter reads its low byte, but the independent LAN name serializer returns empty strings. V7/BV9 acknowledgements omit unknown-name slots; V16+ keep empty-string p/val slots. Modern source dat requires activation0..3 to be at least2; modeled child topology chooses active synthetic board state. Original command/res/status/dat and both banks are qualified separately in AV/alternate-probe-results.json (212 vectors). Exact requested256 wrap is independently checked: UART low byte0 and numeric getter0, but LAN name readout remains empty string.
source_quirks: Timer week transmission uses only the first input integer as a bit mask; the reporter returns seven separate bits. An empty week array retains the previous gateway staging mask, not a per-id mask.
Timer reporter always emits Pow, even when the transmitted selector was another ordinary field.
IFTTT query repeats the same requested index for count iterations and serializes one record, not a count-sized page.
First rule preserves the submitted id; subsequent setIFTTT picks the smallest unused id. Deletion reindexes query positions.
IFTTT conversion does not scale SetTem or remap Mod; the ordinary cmd path does.
The source cJSON_Parse accepts trailing decrypted bytes; the public emulator deliberately retains strict JSON/padding trust boundaries.

Requested root name and host values do not imply effective mutation. Root name reads the root MAC; later Wi-Fi command fields are acknowledged no-ops. Old child rename is a distinct cache operation and takes precedence over ordinary controls; clock updates take precedence over both.
metadata_hid_policy: These sixteen V16 profiles share their source root network getter: requested hid is empty despite the embedded full source identity; root discovery omits hid. Direct raw clients must observe empty hid; unmodified GatewayDevice child qualification must not be given an invented full/trusted hid. The source getter/discovery replay is AV/metadata-probe-results.json, all10 exact images/286 vectors, not model-derived.
